newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korea's 3-yr bond yields close unchanged.
newsitem.headline: South Korea's 3-yr bond yields close unchanged.

text.p: Yields on benchmark three-year corporate bonds closed unchanged on Monday as traders clung to the sidelines following sharp falls in the yields late last week, dealers said.
Three-month CD yields closed lower as the cash liquidity started easing, they said.
* 3-mth CDs end at 14.90 pct vs Saturday's 15.00
* Overnight call average at 17.00 pct vs Saturday's 17.50
"Traders took to the sidelines because they were unsure about the appropriate levels for the three-year yields," said Kim.
Three-month CD yields closed 10 basis points lower at 14.90 percent in line with the easing cash liquidity, dealers said.
They said liquidity eased after the cash demand began slowing.
